name: Ryo
source:
Ryo dresses as a girl because he prefers girls' clothes, but he doesn't identify as a girl. All the same, he doesn't mind if people think he's a girl, because it makes his life easier.

He doesn't make friends easily, and is naturally wary of others, having being bullied in the past for the clothes he wears. All the same, he continues to dress the way he does whenever possible, and refuses to change no matter what people say.

[From in-game Extras]
